_comment: CVSS 3.1 reference vectors for the score-compute engine. Base scores are the values NVD/FIRST publish for these vectors; temporal (Threat) scores are computed per the FIRST CVSS v3.1 specification §7 (formula) and §7.4 roundup, using the documented Exploit Maturity / Remediation Level / Report Confidence constants. Provenance: https://www.first.org/cvss/v3.1/specification-document . Shared by the Go (go/cvss_test.go) and TS (test/cvss.test.ts) tests so both assert identical expected values.

cases.note: E:H(1.0) => temporal equals base (the STIX exploitation bridge case)
no impact (C/I/A all None) => ISS 0 => score 0.0
